# watchpoint_sla_profile (Data Source)

Looks up a single SLA profile by name within the tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_sla_profile" "example" {
  name = "Production SLA"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the SLA profile to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `id` (String) SLA profile ID.
- `target_uptime_percent` (Number) Target uptime percentage.
- `window_days` (Number) Rolling evaluation window in days.
